offering_description.value: Sells mobile deposit capture, digital identity verification and document fraud detection software to banks, credit unions, fintechs and other regulated financial institutions. Delivered mainly as cloud software licensed on subscription or per-transaction terms, with software development kits embedded in customer apps.

primary_products.value: mobile deposit capture software; identity verification software; document fraud detection software; document capture software development kits

primary_services.value: cloud hosting and transaction processing; implementation and integration support; customer support and maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2B: banks, credit unions, fintech companies, insurers, lenders and other regulated businesses; B2G: government agencies that verify citizen identities for benefits or services

end_markets.value: banking; financial services; insurance; fintech; government

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring software subscriptions for identity and deposit capture platforms; transaction or usage fees: per-verification and per-transaction charges for software usage; licensing or royalties: software licenses for embedded mobile capture and verification software; service fees: implementation, integration and support services for customers
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops identity and document software platforms, sold to financial institutions and fintechs; service provider: hosts and processes verification transactions for customers, who pay per use

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States, with customers in Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: mobile deposit capture, digital identity verification and document fraud detection, sold to the same financial customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct enterprise sales teams selling to banks and financial institutions; partners / resellers: technology partners and resellers that embed Mitek software in their products

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Products support KYC, AML and data privacy compliance for banks, the company itself needs no operating license, but must meet data security and privacy rules
